summary: byNordic Acquisition Corp filed an 8-K disclosing a September 11, 2026 promissory note of up to $150,000 issued to Thomas L. Fairfield, its COO/CFO, with an initial $8,850.20 advance bearing no interest and maturing upon the earlier of an initial business combination or 180 days after dissolution. Proceeds fund general working capital, including deposits for extending the SPAC's business combination period, which was pushed to October 12, 2026. Repayment is limited to funds outside the IPO trust account if no deal closes; watch extension deposit cadence and trust-redemption overhang.
